We will start. Today is Friday, November 19, 1993. We are in the home of Dr. Billy Taylor, pianist, composer, recording artist, arranger, conductor, actor, author, teacher, lecturer, radio and television personality, Dr. William Taylor. If there ever was a renaissance man I feel that I am in his presence right now. Good morning Dr. Taylor.
